SELECT BASIS_CYY ccyOriginal, QUOT_CYY ccyConvert, TRADE_DATE publishDate, CLOSE_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) closePrice, OPEN_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) openPrice, HIGH_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) highPrice, LOW_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) lowPrice, MID_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) midPrice FROM MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE info
info.QUOT_CYY = #{ccy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND INFO.DATASOURCE_TYPE = 'SAFE' and info.TRADE_DATE = (select max(t.TRADE_DATE) from MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE t where t.BASIS_CYY = info.BASIS_CYY and t.QUOT_CYY = info.QUOT_CYY AND t.DATASOURCE_TYPE = 'SAFE' and t.TRADE_DATE <= #{date,jdbcType=DATE})
